overlap: Baseline and candidate suites overlapped; this is an acceptance audit, not a controlled strength or Elo comparison.
benchmark_rebuild: The retained benchmark was rebuilt during the original session only to reject malformed CLI numbers. All games used valid numeric arguments. Move-selection code in the retained binary was unchanged, and that binary was frozen for the resumed games.
resumption: The original session saved 26 completed games. Ten unfinished/missing games were rerun on 2026-11-12 using the retained executable, identical runtime/model hashes, and the same explicit six-worker setting. See manifest.json resumptions and legacy_snapshot_migration.
later_source_updates: After freezing the measured executable, source updates capped automatic/explicit allocation to available hardware and ensured that a missing primary expert does not transfer its worker allocation to Alpha. With six requested workers, 36 hardware threads and both experts present, the measured four-Rapfi/one-Alpha/one-local allocation is unchanged.

vcf_audit.scope: Existing bounded VCF prover, not a complete solution or a proof that no stronger move exists.

extra_thread_diagnostic.scope: One diagnostic game, excluded from the 36-game matrix. Binary included automatic/hardware allocation cap and preceded the missing-primary allocation fix.
